vendors.revenue_share_model: Custom / negotiated. SaaS platforms using Stripe Connect are eligible for a 'revenue sharing' program on processing volume; Premier Partner (SaaS track) requires at least $1M in partnership revenue for buy-rate platforms or $300M in payment volume for referral-model platforms. Services-track partners earn referral/co-sell support rather than disclosed percentages. Exact rev-share percentages are not publicly disclosed. ([Stripe SaaS platform partners docs](https://docs.stripe.com/partners/platforms))
vendors.fx_markup_transparency: Not publicly detailed for partners. Stripe discloses over 125+ global payment methods and currency support in its core payments docs, but does not publish standardized FX markup disclosure requirements for partners or end-customers on its partner pages. ([Stripe Sessions 2025 product update](https://stripe.com/blog/top-product-updates-sessions-2025))
vendors.cross_border_coverage: 135+ currencies accepted; 40+ countries with full Stripe account support; 125+ local payment methods; Sessions 2026 previewed Global Payouts to 100+ countries in fiat and 160 countries in stablecoins, plus stablecoin support for 41 additional markets. ([Stripe currencies docs](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies); [Stripe Sessions 2026](https://stripe.com/blog/everything-we-announced-at-sessions-2026))
vendors.embedded_finance_capabilities: Yes. Stripe Connect enables embedded payments, payouts, and marketplace/platform account management; Stripe also offers Issuing, Treasury, Managed Payments, marketplace wallets, Treasury-for-platforms, and previewed stablecoin seller payouts across 100 additional countries. ([Stripe Sessions 2026](https://stripe.com/blog/everything-we-announced-at-sessions-2026); [Stripe Sessions 2025 product update](https://stripe.com/blog/top-product-updates-sessions-2025))
vendors.api_first: Yes. Stripe's entire partner ecosystem is built around API integration (Payment Intents, Connect, Checkout, Payment Element, webhooks). ([Stripe SaaS platform partners docs](https://docs.stripe.com/partners/platforms))
vendors.deal_registration: Yes. Services-track Partner and Premier Partner tiers both have 'Deal registration to request co-selling support' as a stated benefit. ([Stripe Services partners docs](https://docs.stripe.com/partners/services))
vendors.mdf_available: Yes. Both Partner and Premier tiers in the Services track are eligible to request market development funds (MDF); Premier Partners in the SaaS track get MDF as an added benefit. ([Stripe Services partners docs](https://docs.stripe.com/partners/services); [Stripe SaaS platform partners docs](https://docs.stripe.com/partners/platforms))
vendors.annual_partner_fee: No standard published fee for the core Partner Ecosystem; one third-party affiliate resource cites a legacy 'Stripe Verified Partner Program' with a $250/year fee, but this is not corroborated on Stripe's current official pages. ([Wise blog on Stripe affiliate program](https://wise.com/gb/blog/stripe-affiliate-program))
vendors.ecosystem_size: Not disclosed as a specific partner count on official pages; described as 'thousands of trusted partners around the world.' ([Stripe Partner Ecosystem page](https://stripe.com/partners))

recent_program_changes.change: Stripe powered Ramp stablecoin Bill Pay and Stablecoin Accounts through Bridge and Privy, enabling bank-funded stablecoin payments and 24/7 stablecoin balances/payments for businesses, including global supplier payments.

Stripe Sessions 2026 added Treasury and platform capabilities: storage in 15 currencies for US/UK businesses by year-end, stablecoin support for 41 additional markets, noncustodial-wallet-backed cross-border movement in 150+ markets, and marketplace stablecoin rails for seller payouts in 100 additional countries.

Stripe restructured the Partner Ecosystem into a streamlined two-tier model (Stripe Partner and Premier Partner) across four tracks (Services, SaaS platforms, Apps, Payment methods), raising baseline standards for technical expertise, business impact, and customer success.
Seven new partner specializations launched: Agentic Commerce, Radar, Terminal, Retail, Media, Financial Services, and Travel & Hospitality.

Launch of the Stripe Partner Solutions Program, moving partners from custom implementations to repeatable industry solutions on a 70/30 prebuilt-to-customizable model; partners on this model reportedly grew revenue 20% faster year-over-year.

At Stripe Sessions 2025, Stripe previewed Stripe Orchestration (multi-processor management), announced Managed Payments (merchant-of-record offering), and expanded to 125+ global payment methods including stablecoins and real-time rails like Pix and UPI.

vendors.fx_markup_transparency: Not publicly disclosed as a formal standard; Corpay markets 'transparent' cross-border payments experience and forward-contract rate locking for clients (e.g., 45-60 day forward contracts), but does not publish specific FX markup disclosure rules for partners or end-customers. ([AMI Strategies/Corpay partnership announcement](https://amistrategies.com/cambridge-global-payments-announces-partnership-ami-strategies/))
vendors.cross_border_coverage: 145+ currencies with delivery to 200+ countries (per partner integration listings); more broadly, Corpay processes payments in more than 160 currencies around the world; 4.1M+ payments annually and 21,000+ customers on the Cross-Border platform; partners with 100+ correspondent banks across 6 continents. ([Microsoft AppSource Corpay Cross-Border listing](https://appsource.microsoft.com/en-in/product/dynamics-365-for-operations/fleetcortechnologiesinc1637002052602.corpay-cross-border?tab=overview); [Corpay Cross-Border page](https://www.corpay.com/cross-border); [Mastercard/Corpay partnership announcement](https://investor.mastercard.com/investor-news/investor-news-details/2025/Mastercard-and-Corpay-Launch-Strategic-Partnership-in-Cross-Border-Payments/default.aspx))
vendors.embedded_finance_capabilities: Expanded. Corpay now offers embedded stablecoin wallets and settlement through BVNK, including hold/send/receive/store/convert capabilities alongside fiat balances and treasury use; blockchain settlement also runs through J.P. Morgan Kinexys. ([Corpay/BVNK wallets](https://investor.corpay.com/news-releases/news-release-details/corpay-partners-bvnk-add-stablecoin-wallets-global-customers/); [Corpay blockchain settlement](https://investor.corpay.com/news-releases/news-release-details/corpay-signs-jp-morgan-and-bvnk-blockchain-infrastructure/))
vendors.api_first: Partial. Corpay supports 'payment execution through basic file upload or API' — API is an option but not positioned as API-first/API-only the way Stripe or Wise are. ([Corpay Payment Solutions Partner Placemat, 2021](https://www.corpay.com/pdfs/integrated-payments/corpay-payment-solutions-partner-placemat-2021.pdf))
vendors.ecosystem_size: 21,000+ customers on the Cross-Border platform; 100+ correspondent banking and counterparty trading relationships across 6 continents. ([Corpay Cross-Border page](https://www.corpay.com/cross-border); [Corpay Corporate Placemat 2023 PDF](https://assets.ctfassets.net/h83dujey17us/1IkolXWa3LQhnQrUoves82/7c6c8acc92a4fe2c9308de8fb03271c1/Corpay_-_Corporate_Placemat_-_2023.pdf))

recent_program_changes.change: Corpay partnered with BVNK to add embedded stablecoin wallets and settlement: customers can hold, send, receive, store, and convert stablecoins alongside fiat balances, while Corpay uses the rails for treasury and cross-border liquidity.

Corpay added blockchain-based settlement through J.P. Morgan Kinexys and BVNK, extending its multi-rail cross-border platform with 24/7 stablecoin and tokenized-fiat disbursements across select corridors.

Mastercard and Corpay launched a strategic partnership: Mastercard made a $300M minority investment (~3% equity stake, $10.7B enterprise valuation) in Corpay's cross-border business, and Corpay became the exclusive provider of large-ticket cross-border payments and currency risk management to Mastercard's financial institution customers.
Corpay and Mastercard extended near-real-time payments to 22 new markets across Asia, Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Latin America.
Corpay completed Mastercard's $300M minority investment into its cross-border business, targeting first customer conversions from Q1 2026.

Corpay closed its acquisition of Alpha (adding ~$55M in Q4 revenue) and, with TPG, completed acquisition of a 34% stake in AvidXchange, expanding its mid-market AP automation and cross-border risk management footprint.

vendors.program_name: Convera Partner Program (heritage: Western Union Business Solutions)
vendors.revenue_share_model: Not publicly disclosed; Convera markets 'new revenue opportunities' for software and advisory partners without publishing specific percentages or a formal referral/rev-share table. ([Convera Partners page](https://convera.com/partners/))
vendors.fx_markup_transparency: Not publicly disclosed on the partner page.
vendors.cross_border_coverage: 140+ currencies across 200+ countries and territories; processes roughly $190 billion a year in cross-border volume per third-party analysis; built on 40+ years of foreign-exchange expertise inherited from Western Union Business Solutions. ([Convera Partners page](https://convera.com/partners/); [Tom Wang analysis of Convera/Ripple partnership](https://tomcn.uk/news/2026-04-05-convera-ripple-stablecoin-sandwich-cross-border-payments))
vendors.embedded_finance_capabilities: Yes, for software partners. Convera enables partners to 'embed multi-currency payouts into your platform via API,' and as of March 2026 added stablecoin-enabled settlement rails through its Ripple partnership. ([Convera Partners page](https://convera.com/partners/); [Convera/Ripple stablecoin partnership](https://convera.com/blog/company-news/ripple-convera-stablecoin-enabled-global-payments/))
vendors.api_first: Yes. The software/technology partner track is explicitly built around embedding 'multi-currency payouts into your platform via API.' ([Convera Partners page](https://convera.com/partners/))

recent_program_changes.change: Convera announced the final closing of its transition from Western Union Business Solutions, completing its full rebrand and spin-off.

Convera announced a strategic partnership with Ripple to deliver stablecoin-enabled settlement across its 200-country, 140-currency network, capitalizing on the GENIUS Act's new US stablecoin regulatory framework.
Western Union Business Solutions announced its rename to Convera as part of its carve-out from Western Union.
